content:
200 Returned if Tenable MSSP Portal successfully added the logo.
400 Returned if your request specifies invalid query parameter values.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
A brief message about the missing or invalid parameter value(s).
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The HTTP status code of the error.
string
The standard HTTP error name.
string
A brief message about the cause of the error.
